Next week's meetings are set for Council on Aging, library and land use, then fire and police; no Tuesday meeting for the audit presentation.

The school increase, the ladder truck borrowing and the unfunded retiree health liability all shape future tax bills and what Town Meeting will be asked to approve.

Members compared the target budget with the above-target budget; the target education increase was described as about half the above-target increase.
The committee asked the town manager for visibility into the 10-year capital list, and he said he is working on it.
Most capital discussion covered financing a new fire engine over five years, with annual paydown roughly matching payments that are ending on other debt.
No votes were taken except adjournment; members noted a Feb 13 property condition assessment presentation to the Selectmen.

why_it_matters: The target and above-target budgets, and the choice to pay for a fire engine over five years, shape how much the FY19 town budget, mostly taxes, grows and what Town Meeting is asked to approve.
The 10-year capital list and the building condition assessment point to future project costs that may reach residents as borrowing or tax requests.
